fields.app_value: See notes -- share counts, EPS series and fiscal year-ends inconsistent with Icon Facilitators Ltd
fields.outside_value: N/A (not a pack field; cross-checked against pack's own income-history figures instead)
fields.note: The sidecar's /fundamentals/ICON/income, /balance and /cashflow calls (provider 'openbb-mcp', collected.json:547-2007) return statements for what appears to be a DIFFERENT company than Icon Facilitators Ltd: (a) periods end 2025-12-31 / 2024-12-31 / etc. (calendar year-end), while Icon Facilitators is an India BSE filer with a March fiscal year-end and half-yearly (not annual) disclosure (pack: 'half_yearly_not_quarterly' trap); (b) weighted_average_basic_shares_outstanding runs 6,152 / 7,250 / 3,903 / 397,776 across 2022-2025 (collected.json:786-793), which does not match Icon Facilitators' actual share history (10,000 pre-IPO -> 78,59,600 post-IPO per pack's own eps_series_not_restated_1000x trap); (c) net_income for 2025 and 2024 is NEGATIVE (-4,197,000 and -210,000, collected.json:716-717,825-826), while Icon Facilitators was profitable in every year FY22-FY26 per the pack (net profit 0.94/1.92/1.76/4.47/4.42 INR crore). This is consistent with the pack's own traps.three_way_in_app_ticker_collision warning that 'ICON' also resolves inside the app's own us_instruments.json master to a different company ('Icon Energy Corp'). By contrast, the /fundamentals/ICON top-level payload (yfinance-sourced) IS correctly scoped to the Indian entity (market cap, shares outstanding, revenue_ttm, book_value all reconcile to Icon Facilitators' real numbers) -- so this looks like a provider-routing bug specific to the openbb-mcp-backed statement endpoints, not the resolver itself. FILED as DAT-P6-1 (critical).
